scope: Exploratory amplitude-matched terminal axis response; not exact axis matching or learned law transfer
primary_metric: Angle between normalized mean terminal axes in nominal and tilted conditions; each roll/pitch sign reported separately
sim_terminal: All solver_phase==6 frames, per-episode unit-axis mean; also sensitivity using last frame and last 50 percent of phase6
real_terminal: Existing fixed pre-release 0.5 second window ending 0.2 second before release
failures: Keep all attempts; missing phase6 explicitly recorded, no successful-retry selection
equivalence_margin_reason: No independently justified calibration/tolerance budget supplied; report effect discrepancies and intervals, no equivalence pass/fail
